title: Grok/X feed
description: A file the user controls, which Grok appends to and the news poller reads. See docs/grok-x-feed-schema.md. Every constraint mirrors a gate that already exists in pipeline/learning/file_claim.py; none of it is new policy.

generated_at.description: When the file was written. Never used for recency; claimed_at is.

availability.description: Team news. Can push availability DOWN via R4, which is why every field is required.

claim_type.description: FILEABLE in file_claim.py. `status` is FPL's own field and `predicted_start` belongs to the minutes model; neither is fileable.

value.description: Shape depends on claim_type. Enforced in pipeline/data/grok_feed.py; see valueRules.

player_surname.description: As FPL spells it. Resolved our side; ambiguity within a club escalates rather than being guessed.

tier.description: Tier 1 is reserved for FPL's own fields. A paraphrase is tier 3 at best.

quote.description: VERBATIM from the source, never a summary. Omit rather than paraphrase.

claimed_at.description: When the SOURCE said it. A future value is rejected.

comparator.description: Someone else's projections. Never enters the availability store, so it carries no tier and needs no quote.

valueRules.description: JSON Schema cannot express these conditionals readably, so they are enforced in pipeline/data/grok_feed.py: chance_of_playing = integer 0-100 (not '25%'); expected_minutes = number 0-90; return_date and unavailable_until = exactly YYYY-MM-DD; permanent_exit = object with kind in transfer|loan|free_agent (a bare string is recorded and then silently dropped by R0); severity and unparsed_news = free text.
